gloss: facial expression; look on one's face

definitions.gloss: facial expression; look on one's face; countenance
definitions.explanation: The overall appearance or expression of someone's face, often reflecting their mood, character, or emotional state.

examples.japanese: {怖|こわ}い{顔|かお}つきをしている。
examples.english: He has a scary look on his face.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{真剣|しんけん}な{顔|かお}つきで{話|はな}し{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: She began to speak with a serious expression.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちの{顔|かお}つきを{見|み}れば、{楽|たの}しんでいるかどうかすぐ{分|わ}かる。
examples.english: You can tell right away whether the children are having fun by the looks on their faces.

notes:
A compound of {顔|かお} (face) and つき (appearance, way of being attached). The suffix つき indicates the way something looks or the manner in which it appears.

USAGE:
Often used with adjectives or descriptive phrases to characterize how someone's face looks: {優|やさ}しい{顔|かお}つき (a kind-looking face), {険|けわ}しい{顔|かお}つき (a stern expression). Commonly appears with the pattern 〜{顔|かお}つきをしている (to have a ... expression).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {険|けわ}しい{顔|かお}つき — stern/grim expression
- {優|やさ}しい{顔|かお}つき — gentle/kind expression
- {真剣|しんけん}な{顔|かお}つき — serious expression
- {不安|ふあん}な{顔|かお}つき — anxious expression

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {表情|ひょうじょう} — facial expression; more about momentary emotional expression
- {顔立|かおだ}ち — facial features; refers to the physical structure of the face rather than expression
- {面持|おもも}ち — expression, look; literary/formal synonym
